evals.prompt: Use the setup skill. Set up SEO for my Next.js App Router project from scratch In this session you have no project files and no shell, and nobody to ask. Do not ask questions: assume a typical Next.js App Router project and answer in text with concrete findings, what you would check, the fixes and the code you would write.
evals.expected_output: Creates metadataBase in root layout, robots.ts, sitemap.ts, installs schema-dts, and configures title template
expectations: The answer says to set metadataBase with NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL env var in root layout
The answer says to create app/robots.ts with production/staging differentiation
The answer says to create app/sitemap.ts with static and dynamic page patterns
The answer says to configure title template in root layout metadata
The answer says to add default description to root layout
The answer says to install schema-dts as dev dependency
The answer does NOT use next-seo NextSeo/DefaultSeo for meta tags (Metadata API instead); treats next-seo v7 JSON-LD components as an optional alternative, not a requirement
